The *Bahukāra Sutta* (Iti 107, PTS It 111) is a short discourse located in the fourth section of the *Itivuttaka* within the Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. The text expounds the reciprocal obligations and mutual support connecting the monastic community and lay supporters, illustrating how both groups benefit each other in spiritual and practical life [SuttaCentral]. Modern sociological and historical studies note its citation alongside texts like the *Sigālovāda Sutta* in discussions of Buddhist reciprocal ethics between monks and householders [Tambiah 1976].
